 Here are the best discounts we’ve found so far on WIRED-tested gadgets. Courtesy of SteelSeries Save Story Save this story Save Story Save this story Things have pretty much never been more expensive . I’ve found the best deals on WIRED-tested tech that we’d actually recommend, from a great gaming headset to a smart bird feeder. These discounted picks could be a low-cost upgrade for yourself, and they’d also make great gifts this holiday season.
 Even if the main sales aren’t for another week, these are the best early Black Friday deals we’ve come across on the WIRED-tested gear we recommend—and that’s actually worth buying. All of these sales bring the price down to $100 or under, which is no small feat in today’s economy. Check back often, as we’ll update this guide with the new picks we’ve found leading up to the main Black Friday and Cyber Monday sales event.
 Want more deals? We have even more discounts on WIRED-tested tech here . Plus, read our related shopping guides to make the most of Black Friday sales, including how to avoid scams and sketchy wares on Amazon , Amazon Prime perks you might not know about , and Black Friday shopping tips .

 Photograph: Simon Hill

 Chevron Chevron Save to wishlist Save to wishlist TP-Link
 Archer BE230
 $120 $98 (18% off) Amazon
 $144 $130 (10% off) Shop
 This  budget Wi-Fi router  goes on sale often, but we always recommend folks upgrade to this model when it dips in price before the holidays. It has four antennas, a 2.5-Gbps WAN, a 2.5-Gbps LAN, three gigabit LAN ports, and dual-band 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Wi-Fi options. It may not be the best pick if your computing needs require a heavier lift, but for a small home with a few people, it works perfectly.

 Rapid Pro Power Bank
 $126 $70 (44% off) Amazon (20,000 mAh)
 This is reviewer Simon Hill's favorite power bank for laptops because it can keep your laptop, phone, and other gadgets powered up on the go. It has a 27,650-mAh capacity (which is conveniently allowed on flights), three USB-C ports (rated at 140 watts, 65 watts, and 65 watts), and a retractable 2-foot USB-C cable (rated at 140 watts).

 This is one of our favorite 3-in-1 chargers to keep your essentials charged on a single outlet: phone, AirPods, and Apple Watch. It has height adjustability, which is handy because the stand can shift into a tripod for shooting video or FaceTime calls.

 BoostCharge Pro 2-in-1 Wireless Charging Dock with MagSafe

 This was our longtime top 2-in-1 pick for charging an iPhone and Apple Watch simultaneously. It has a pleasant soft-touch finish, an Apple Watch shelf that works with any strap, and a top pad that tilts through 70 degrees.

 $109 $98 (10% off) Shop
 $90 Amazon
 $80 Best Buy
 This charging tree suspends two Apple devices in midair, while its broad circular base has a spot for your AirPods case. It charges your iPhone at up to 15 watts and can fast-charge an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer (older models charge more slowly). It’s also  Qi2 certified.  The charging pad tilts to your preferred angle, and you can turn your iPhone to landscape to watch a video as it charges or activate  StandBy mode  with weather information on display.

 Sexy Bedroom Lights
 Photograph: Simon Hill Save to wishlist Save to wishlist Govee
 Neon Rope Light Strip 2
 $100 $70 (30% off) Amazon
 As a younger millennial, these rope lights give me PTSD. One day, a few years ago, it seemed that all men aged 18 to 32 decided that colorful rope lights in the bedroom were sexy. I just think it made them feel like they were Ryan Gosling in  Drive . Chill, Dalton, you drive a Kia. Now that almost half a decade has passed, I can begin to appreciate these  smart lights ’ aesthetic. It’s an easy way to make your space feel a little more colorful, moodier, and personal.
